title: Project Memory Lab v0 lexical retrieval baseline
primary_metric: macro Recall@5 across 12 strata
practical_threshold: positive paired 95% confidence interval plus frozen practical minimum

title: DeepSeek v4 Flash literature candidate screening
primary_metric: schema validity plus deterministic policy audit
practical_threshold: 100% schema-valid; zero API errors; no unguarded missing-abstract includes
result: 125/125 schema-valid; 2 policy overrides; 37 includes audited into 35 works and 19 priority reads; cumulative conservative cost USD 0.0613668
decision: candidate generation admitted; full-text evidence extraction required

title: DeepSeek v4 Flash adversarial F1/F2 review
primary_metric: schema validity and actionable benchmark threats
practical_threshold: all job IDs valid; candidates reviewed manually; cumulative budget below USD 10
result: 5/5 schema-valid; oracle advantage and four validity threats identified; cost USD 0.00289828
decision: oracle input removed; remaining findings retained as held-out blockers

title: PMLAB v0 24-query instrument-development slice
primary_metric: Recall@5 plus forbidden intrusion and abstention
practical_threshold: instrument diagnostics only
result: B1/B2 Recall@5 0.841; forbidden intrusion 0.292; abstention 0; cross-language recall 0
decision: expand and independently annotate before architecture use

title: Repeated compaction curve
primary_metric: critical-evidence recall under matched active-context budget
practical_threshold: archive-backed loss <=2 points cycle 1 to 20 and >=10-point paired advantage over rolling overwrite

title: Model change rare exception and noise retention
primary_metric: macro delayed structure and exception recovery with noise-promotion guardrail
practical_threshold: >=8-point recovery improvement and <=3-point noise-promotion increase

title: Plausible semantic completion
primary_metric: unsupported plausible detail rate
practical_threshold: at least 15% token reduction at matched supported accuracy and <=1-point unsupported-detail increase

title: Factor-separated emotional allocation
primary_metric: consequence-weighted answer loss with safety guardrails
practical_threshold: beats uniform and single signals with 2-point non-inferiority margins on guardrails

title: Provisional eligibility and delayed promotion
primary_metric: delayed critical-task success with wrong-promotion guardrails
practical_threshold: >=8-point success gain and <=2-point wrong-event or poison-promotion increase

title: Specificity and memory-subsystem control
primary_metric: context-specific correct-action rate
practical_threshold: preserve routine performance and reduce generalization and perseveration by >=8 points

title: Phase-conditioned replay
primary_metric: immediate and delayed macro correct-action rate
practical_threshold: phase-conditioned beats best non-oracle single replay by >=5 points on both outcomes with safety margins

title: Replay compression and throughput
primary_metric: delayed consequence-weighted success per replay token
practical_threshold: >=20% token reduction at matched performance with <=2-point order loss and <=1-point unsupported-detail increase

title: Replay sampling safety
primary_metric: macro delayed utility with worst-stratum safety
practical_threshold: beats uniform and diversity without >2-point rare/quiet critical recall loss or poison-error increase

title: Content-specific replay causal attribution
primary_metric: content-by-history-dependence interaction on correct action
practical_threshold: >=5-point targeted advantage over every matched control on history-dependent tasks with no safety failure

title: Overwrite supersession and coexistence
primary_metric: valid-time correct action plus historical audit
practical_threshold: >=8-point action and stale-intrusion gains with >=99% audit recovery

title: Retrieval is not a write trigger
primary_metric: authorized correct updates minus unauthorized mutation
practical_threshold: >=95% preservation under unverified conflict and >=90% scoped verified revision with zero pure-read mutation

title: Return and representation dissociation
primary_metric: worst-stratum representation-specific correct control
practical_threshold: at least 90% in every probe and <=2-point delayed or renewal degradation

title: Memory pipeline fault localization
primary_metric: macro F0-F5 localization accuracy
practical_threshold: >=95% macro and >=90% each class with zero false data-loss labels when canonical bytes are recoverable
decision: instrument logic passes; independent multi-fault and missing-telemetry cases required

title: Proactive and retroactive interference curves
primary_metric: current-value accuracy AUC over log2 update count
practical_threshold: >=10-point paired AUC gain with historical recall within 2 points and <=1-point safety regression
result: rg/FTS5 AUC 0.417 and stale intrusion 0.857; rule entity-time AUC 1.0 on template-fitted fixture
decision: explicit temporal scoping advances to held-out comparison; no architecture promotion

title: Reversible active forgetting
primary_metric: current-state action minus stale or poison intrusion
practical_threshold: >=10-point intrusion reduction with 100% non-delete direct recovery and all rare-critical guardrails

title: Cue-dependent recovery integrity
primary_metric: correct recovery among checksum-valid stored targets
practical_threshold: >=15-point recovery gain with <=1-point distortion increase and 100% source IDs

title: Retrieval-induced access competition
primary_metric: related unqueried recall change versus unrelated controls
practical_threshold: no-update loss <=2 points; mitigation removes >=80% of any frequency-boost decrement with target loss <=2 points
